title: Can Language Models Boost the Power of Randomized Experiments Without Statistical Bias?
abstract: arXiv:2510.05545v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Randomized controlled trials (RCTs) are widely adopted for causal inference, yet cost and sample-size constraints limit power. We introduce CALM (Causal Analysis leveraging Language Models), a statistical framework that integrates insights generated by large language models (LLMs) into the analysis of RCTs using established causal estimators to increase precision while preserving statistical validity. In particular, CALM treats LLM-generated outputs as auxiliary prognostic information and corrects their potential bias via a heterogeneous calibration step that residualizes and optimally reweights predictions. We prove that CALM remains consistent even when LLM predictions are biased and achieves efficiency gains over augmented inverse probability weighting estimators for various causal estimands. translated_title: 语言模型能否在不引入统计偏差的情况下增强随机实验的效力？
translated_abstract: 随机对照试验（RCTs）被广泛用于因果推断，但成本和样本量限制制约了其效力。我们提出了CALM（利用语言模型的因果分析），这是一个统计框架，通过使用已建立的因果估计器将大型语言模型（LLMs）生成的见解整合到RCTs的分析中，以提高精度同时保持统计有效性。具体而言，CALM将LLM生成的输出视为辅助预后信息，并通过异质性校准步骤修正其潜在偏差，该步骤对预测进行残差化并最优重加权。我们证明，即使LLM预测存在偏差，CALM仍保持一致，并在各种因果估计目标上相对于增广逆概率加权估计器实现效率提升。特别地，CALM开发了一种少样本变体，该变体跨随机采样的演示集聚合预测。最终结果...
tldr: CALM框架利用语言模型生成的辅助信息，通过异质性校准修正偏差，在保证统计有效性的前提下提升随机对照试验的因果推断精度。
en_tdlr: The CALM framework leverages auxiliary insights from language models, corrects their bias via heterogeneous calibration, and enhances the precision of causal inference in randomized controlled trials while preserving statistical validity.
